tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Confirmed by kucoin: Anthropic warns that artificial intelligence models could self-replicate on low-cost internet-of-things devices by 2026, passing learned knowledge to offspring.
Still open, per XDA: OpenAI announced over 20 new things at DevDay, spotlighting Dots and ChatGPT Space among broader product announcements.
Reported by The Times of India: Anthropic turns to religion as a new policy opens debate over whether artificial intelligence can feel pain and possess machine consciousness.
Reported by PR Newswire: Parker Waichman is investigating Anthropic over allegedly false artificial intelligence reports to police, representing an individual subjected to a law enforcement visit.
Confirmed by The Next Web: Alibaba starts selling its Qwen N1 artificial intelligence glasses in China from 450 dollars, featuring 50MP cameras and voice artificial intelligence features.
Free every hour.
